048-01_falling-agitated-wide-rise-giveba.sentence: Consequence: Up days in a falling, agitated market are short-lived squeezes, and the share of the gain later given back grows with the rise's size and the day's range together.

047-01.g1_agitated-wide-up-day-next-day-.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, on a day a coin closes higher, the wider that day's high-to-low range against the coin's usual daily range, the larger its fall over the next day.

067-02.b1.b1.d1.d2.b2_agitated-chop-fall.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, the further a coin's close sits below its close of 30 days earlier, measured as a plain percent of that earlier close, the more it falls over the next 10 days.

058-02.b1.b1.g2_calm-uptrend-dip-three-d.sentence: In a rising, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against its usual daily swing over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next 3 days.

038-01.g2_scaled-rally-continues-calm-up.sentence: In a rising, calm market, a coin keeps rising over the next 3 days, more so the larger its 3-day return measured in units of the standard deviation of its daily returns over the last 30 days.

077-01.b1.b1.g1_choppy-calm-swing-fall-c.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, a coin whose 14-day return is negative against its own daily swing over the past 30 days keeps falling over the next 7 days, and the larger that swing-scaled fall, the larger the further fall.

041-01.g1_wide-down-day-range-bounce.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the wider a down day's high-to-low range against the coin's 30-day standard deviation of daily returns, the larger the coin's rise over the next day.

065-01.b1_slide-ending-sharp-day-rebound.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, after a coin's five-day fall, the larger the fall of the last of those days, the larger the coin's rise over the next day.

067-02.b1.b1.b1.b1.g2_choppy-calm-upside.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, the further a coin's close stands above its 20-day average, counted in units of its 20-day standard deviation of daily returns, the more the coin rises over the next 10 days.

058-01.g2.g1.d1.d1.b1_deep-fall-bounce-a.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, a coin's up day that comes after a 3-day fall is followed by a fall over the next day, and the deeper that 3-day fall against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger the next-day fall.

067-01.b1.g1.b1.d1.d2.g1_choppy-calm-mon.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's 30-day return is in either direction, the further it moves the same way over the next 10 days, so that a stronger month rise is followed by a larger rise and a deeper month fall by a larger fall.

061-01.d1.d1_rising-calm-big-day-follow-.sentence: In a rising, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day rise against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.

033-02.d1_high-close-fades-in-selloffs.sentence: A close pinned near the high during an agitated decline is a short for the next day, while the same close in a rising market is no reason to sell.

063-02_agitated-5day-drop-bounce-fade.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, on a coin's first up day after a multi-day slide, the larger the fall of its 5-day return up to the day before the bounce against its 30-day swing of daily returns, the larger the coin's fall over the next day.

061-01.g1.d1.d2.d2.g2_choppy-calm-day-fo.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day move against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further the coin keeps moving the same way over the next 5 days, wherever the close sits against its recent highs.

078-01_choppy-agitated-wide-rally-fade.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, an up day whose high-to-low range is wide against the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days is followed by a fall over the next day, and the wider that day's range against its 20-day average, the larger the fall.

032-01.b1_monthly-low-exhaustion-rebound.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, when a coin closes below the lowest close of its previous 30 days, it rebounds over the next 7 days, and the further the close sits below that prior 30-day low, the larger the rebound.

064-01_falling-calm-up-day-fades.sentence: In a falling, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day rise measured in units of its own 30-day standard deviation of daily returns, the larger the fall in its close over the next 3 days.

058-02.b1.b2.b1.b2.b2.e1.g1_choppy-calm-.sentence: Idea: In a choppy, calm market, the nearer a coin's close sits to the top of its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 10 days, and the nearer to the bottom, the larger its fall.

034-01.b1.g1_calm-rising-nearness-drift.sentence: Idea: In a rising, calm market, the closer a coin's daily close sits below its 20-day high, measured in units of its own daily swing over the last 20 days, the more it rises over the next 10 days, and more still the further the close stands above that high.

077-03.d1.b1.b1_wide-high-close-next-day.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, a day that closes near its high on a range wide against the coin's 30-day swing is followed by a fall over the next day.

041-02.g1_agitated-fall-down-day-range-b.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against its 30-day average daily range, the larger its rise over the next day.

058-03.g1.g1_calm-downtrend-weekly-fall-.sentence: Idea: In a falling, calm market, a coin that has fallen over its last 5 days keeps falling over the next 5 days, and the further it has fallen over those 5 days, the more it falls next, whatever the volume of the fall.

058-01.g2.g1.g1.d1.d1.d1_deep-rejected-r.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the first up day after a down day is followed by a fall over the next day only when the rally was sold off well below its high.

033-01.d2_falling-agitated-fall-rebound.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day fall measured against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next day.

074-01_falling-calm-month-rise-continues.sentence: In a falling, calm market, a coin whose 30-day return is positive keeps rising over the next 10 days, and the larger that 30-day rise is against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the same 30 days, the larger the rise that follows.

058-01.g2.g1.d1.d2.b1_wide-bounce-fade-a.sentence: Idea: In a falling, agitated market, a coin's up day that comes while its 3-day return is still negative is followed by a fall over the next day, and the wider that day's high-to-low range against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger the next-day fall.

032-02.b1.b1.b1_agitated-choppy-break-re.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, when a coin's daily close is below the lowest low of its prior 20 days, its price rises over the next day, and the further the close sits below that low, the larger the rise.

033-01.g1_calm-uptrend-dip-rebound.sentence: In a rising, calm market, a down day is followed by a rise over the next 3 days, and the rise is larger the more that day's fall exceeds the coin's usual daily swing (the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days).

061-01.d2.b1_rising-calm-continuation-mo.sentence: In a rising, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day rise against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next 5 days.
